criteria.criterion: With a reachable remote advertising the configured tickets branch but no local remote-tracking ref, a simulated bounded fetch failure returns nonzero and creates no orphan branch. Tier: CLI subprocess with real temporary repositories.
With a reachable remote that does not advertise the configured branch, init still bootstraps successfully. Tier: CLI subprocess negative control.

With an unreachable or timing-out remote, explicit init and strict auto-init return nonzero within one probe bound, create no orphan branch, and emit an error distinct from advertised/fetch-failed. Strict auto-init does not enter the consent prompt. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_init_fail_closed.py -k unreachable -v.

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort treats unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, returns without error, and never supplies force_new_store=True; the following strict path reuses the cached result and reports the actionable failure.
rebar init --force-new-store and rebar.init_repo(force_new_store=True) permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established. Tier: CLI subprocess plus library interface test.

With a reachable advertised branch, --force-new-store is ineffective: the command warns, attempts normal bounded fetch, and returns nonzero without an orphan if fetch fails. With reachable-absent, it warns and follows normal successful bootstrap. Tier: CLI subprocess negative controls.
Failure messages name the configured remote, configured branch, timeout where applicable, and concrete fetch/retry or force-new-store remediation. Tier: unit assertions on stderr.

An existing healthy store remains idempotent, does not invoke the advertisement probe, and is unaffected by the override default. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_init_fail_closed.py -k idempotent -v.

pending_init_attaches_to_existing returns true when the remote advertises the branch despite no local remote-tracking ref, and false for reachable-absent and unreachable. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_init_attach_predicate.py -v.

Behavioral wiring tests monkeypatch the one shared probe and prove _mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, and _create_tracker consume it; a second independent remote-existence predicate fails the tests.

One CLI invocation performs at most one underlying advertisement probe on the unreachable path; advancing the injected monotonic clock past the short TTL causes a fresh probe. Tier: unit orchestration test.
Existing timeout tests continue proving cold fetch retains its 300-second bound, while new tests prove the advertisement probe has its own positive short bound and folds timeout to return code 124.

rebar init --help and generated docs/cli-reference.md both contain --force-new-store and its deliberate-bootstrap semantics. Proving commands: rebar init --help | grep -- --force-new-store and grep -- --force-new-store docs/cli-reference.md.
